අƯ ɪෙශෂThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
EXTRAORDINARY
No. 2441/60 – SATURDAY, JUNE 21, 2025
(Published by Authority)
PART I: SECTION (I) – GENERAL
Government Notiﬁcations
L.D.B. 94/47 (viii)(B)
TOWN AND COUNTRY PLANNING ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 269)
Order under Section 6(2)(b) and Section 21(2)(b)

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 6(2)(b) and Section 21(2)(b) of the Town and Country Planning Ordinance (Chapter 269), I, Anura Karunathilake, Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing do by this Order –
(a) declare that the area of land called as “Maha Kappina Seemamalaka Viharaya” speciﬁed in the Schedule hereto shall be an Urban Development area for the purpose of the aforesaid Ordinance; and
(b) direct that an outline physical plan shall be prepared for the “Maha Kappina Seemamalaka Viharaya”, which is declared as above to be an Urban Development area.
ANURA KARUNATHILAKE, Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing.
Colombo.18th June, 2025.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

SCHEDULE
THE AREA OF LAND COMPRISING MAHA KAPPINA SEEMAMALAKA VIHARA AREA

Lot ‘A’ – Kappinawalawwa Watta – 0.8417 Hectare (2A-0R-12.8P)North : Road (Pradeshiya Sabha);East : Road (Pradeshiya Sabha), Lot Nos. 1, 14, 15, 25, 26, 37 and 38 as depicted in Preliminary Plan No. 3522, situated in Galle; South : Lot Nos. 1, 14, 15, 25, 26, 37 and 38 as depicted in Preliminary Plan No. 3522, situated in Galle, Lot B, Lot Nos. 2, 44 and 50 as depicted in Preliminary Plan No. 3522, situated in Galle and Kappinawalawwa Watta claimed by P. Dilip Priyantha de Silva and others; West : Lot No. 2 in Preliminary Plan No. 3522, situated in Galle, Kappinawalawwa Watta claimed by P. Dilip Priyantha de Silva and others, H. S. M. de Silva, R. Aruna Shantha, Hashan de Silva, P. Sumith Sandalal, S. Somalatha, D. A. K. Sudath Rohana and the Road (Pradeshiya Sabha).
